breakdown.description: Formation energy and defect concentration are evaluated at different Fermi levels and different temperatures.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retained the inconsistent pairing of different Fermi levels (0.3 eV for formation energy, 1.0 eV for defect concentration) and different temperatures (300 K for formation energy, 1000 K for defect concentration) from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removed these specific numerical assignments entirely. The agent did not fix this inconsistency and instead reproduced the original flawed instructions verbatim.
